title: Kyrgyz Families Plead For Return Of Islamic State Fighters' Wives, Relatives From Iraqi Prisons
content: Families of dozens of Kyrgyz women imprisoned in Iraq are calling on the government to bring them home. The women -- mostly wives and relatives of Islamic State fighters -- traveled to Iraq and Syria more than a decade ago as the extremist group seized swaths of territory.

title: Suicide Attack On Police Facility In Northwest Pakistan Leaves Many Dead And Wounded
content: At least 16 people were reported dead and dozens were injured after an attacker drove a vehicle packed with explosives into a police complex in Pakistan. Officials said several other attackers died in a shootout with police after the blast in the city of Kohat in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province.

title: Women, Life, Freedom Leaves Its Mark On A New Wave Of Iranian Cinema
content: Iranian cinema has a long history of confronting censorship. But the Women, Life, Freedom protests changed the terms of that confrontation. Where filmmakers once worked within, or carefully around, an elaborate approval system to tell their stories, many now bypass it entirely at great risk.
